author: (A. d'Orbigny, 1841)

note.en: A bubble snail of about 6 mm known here from a single 1945 museum specimen labelled Limón, with no habitat recorded.
note.es: Una babosa burbuja de unos 6 mm conocida aquí por un solo ejemplar de museo de 1945 rotulado Limón, sin hábitat registrado.

evidence: SeaLifeBase: depth 2 to 86 m, length 0.6 cm

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón

marks.en: Small white bubble snail with a thin, mostly hidden shell and a soft, smooth body.
marks.es: Caracol burbuja blanco y pequeño con concha delgada casi oculta y cuerpo blando y liso.
